personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for transport utility and trust)
personality_one_liner: Calm, high-contrast, zero-noise mobility command center engineered for instant clarity and passenger-driver trust.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room, consistent 16px screen framing, compact 8px stacking for ride metrics and chips.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky search bars, bottom sheets, and the bottom tab bar.
Ensure ≥75% surface tint opacity over map and background imagery.
dont's: Never blur form inputs or active modal buttons.
Never rely on blur alone without solid surface tint.

screens.name: AuthOTP
screens.purpose: Secure mobile number entry and real SMS OTP verification with instant role-based handoff.

states.loading: Centered emerald spinner while verifying token with backend
states.empty: Clean phone input with international prefix and clear action state
states.error: Inline error banner with clear retry action for invalid SMS codes

screens.layout: Vertical stacked card with hero brand mark, clean phone text input, sticky bottom verify button with safe area clearance.

screens.name: RoleSwitch
screens.purpose: Seamless toggle between Passenger mode and Driver/Host mode to access corresponding toolsets.

states.loading: Skeleton loading grid for role capabilities
states.empty: Role cards with visual feature summaries
states.error: Retry prompt if role sync fails

screens.layout: Two equal prominent feature cards side-by-side or stacked vertically with distinct icons and active emerald border state.

screens.name: PassengerHome
screens.purpose: Interactive map-backed booking hub for searching routes, selecting ride modes, and filtering vehicles.

states.loading: Skeleton shimmer over map container and ride card slots
states.empty: Recent destinations empty state with quick saved locations
states.error: Map tile loading error banner with offline retry

screens.layout: Full-bleed map background with floating frosted search bar at top, horizontal mode chips, and expandable bottom sheet for ride options.

screens.name: RideList
screens.purpose: Browse scheduled and petrol-saving carpool rides matching user query with seat availability.

states.empty: Friendly illustration with search reset CTA
states.error: Connection error state with reload button

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable feed with 16px side padding, compact ride cards featuring driver avatar, vehicle tag, route stops, and price badge.

screens.name: RideCheckout
screens.purpose: Seat selection, coupon application (WEEKLY50), passenger ID verification check, and secure payment confirmation.

states.error: Payment declined alert modal with alternative method prompt

screens.layout: Collapsible summary header, interactive seat grid selector, coupon code input row, breakdown footer with sticky pay button.

screens.name: ActiveTripTracking
screens.purpose: Live map tracking, boarding OTP display, SOS emergency button, and driver communication.

states.loading: Connecting to GPS tracking socket indicator
states.error: GPS signal lost banner with reconnect retry

screens.layout: Full-screen live map with top boarding OTP badge, floating driver detail card in lower third, and prominent SOS emergency action button.

screens.name: DriverDashboard
screens.purpose: Driver hub to post rides, specify licence/RC, route stops, vehicle details, seat capacity, and pricing.

states.loading: Loading active ride list and earnings overview
states.empty: Prompt to publish first carpool ride
states.error: Failed to sync ride data error state

screens.layout: Tabbed dashboard with earnings summary card at top, active rides list below, and floating action button to publish new trip.

map_bg_light.alt: Stylized map and urban routing background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the complete SafarWay passenger and driver ride-sharing experience with backend persistence, real OTP authentication flow, seat selection, coupon code WEEKLY50, SOS emergency simulation, driver ride posting with vehicle RC/licence verification, and glassmorphic bottom sheets. Adhere strictly to the dark utility theme with emerald accents, safe area insets, and ≥44pt touch targets.
